lines.text: Many learners say: How do you think about this?
Better: What do you think about this?
Ask what, not how, for ideas.
What! What do you think about it?

data.wrong: How do you think about this?
data.right: What do you think about this?
data.why: Ask what, not how, for ideas.

native.hook: “Bạn nghĩ thế nào” dịch sao đây?
native.tip: Tiếng Việt hỏi “nghĩ thế nào”, nhưng tiếng Anh hỏi “What do you think.”
native.caption: Bạn có hay nói “How do you think about this?” không? 🤔 Hỏi ý kiến thì dùng “What”: “What do you think about this?” Nghe thầy Carlos đọc rồi lặp lại nhé! Luyện thêm trong app Lexkite.
native.comment: Đáp án: “What.” Hỏi ý kiến bạn bè bằng “What do you think…” nhé! Luyện thêm miễn phí tại đây: {link}

en.hook: How do you ask for an opinion?
en.tip: English asks “What do you think”, not “How do you think.”
en.caption: Do you often say this? “How do you think about this?” Say “What do you think about this?” instead. Listen to Carlos, then repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
